page_title: NAN 3-1 LEN | Nantes v Lens 23/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Jerome Brisard has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+9' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+8' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Angelo Fulgini (Lens) gets booked.
90+8' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) takes the corner which is cleared.
90+8' The corner is swung in but Lens can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. Lens win a corner.
90+5' 3 - 1 Meschack Elia (Nantes) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
90+4' Antoine Kombouare decides to make a substitution. Louis Leroux will be replaced by Marcus Coco (Nantes).
90+4' Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
90+1' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

90+1' Matthis Abline (Nantes) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mathew Ryan.
90' The substitution is prepared. Francis Coquelin (Nantes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Moses Simon.
85' Substitution. Tom Pouilly (Lens) has come on for Ruben Aguilar.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is coming onto the pitch as Anass Zaroury cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Antoine Kombouare has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Meschack Elia (Nantes) replacing Kelvin Amian.
85' Substitution. Mostafa Mohamed makes way for Sorba Thomas (Nantes).
82' This is a yellow card! Anthony Lopes (Nantes) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
81' Louis Leroux (Nantes) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
79' Jerome Brisard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) and blew his whistle.
76' What a chance that is! Anass Zaroury (Lens) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
75' Neat passing move from Lens in order to create new attacking opportunities.
72' Florian Sotoca (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Wesley Said.
70' The referee shows a red card! M'Bala Nzola (Lens) has to leave the pitch.
66' It must be a yellow card. It is. Adrien Thomasson (Lens) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
66' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle after Adrien Thomasson (Lens) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
65' 2 - 1 Goal! Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Anthony Lopes to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
65' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
64' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
64' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Lens using VAR. Let's see what happens.
64' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
63' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
60' 2 - 0 Goal! Moses Simon (Nantes) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mathew Ryan into the bottom left corner.
60' Moses Simon (Nantes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
60' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
59' Celebrations by Nantes are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
59' That looked a certain handball by Malang Sarr (Lens) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
58' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) is punished with the yellow card.

57' Moses Simon (Nantes) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. Nantes force a corner. They send men into the box.
57' The resulting corner, taken by Neil El Aynaoui (Lens), comes to nothing.
56' Lens have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
54' Here is a change. Goduine Koyalipou is going off and Will Still gives the last tactical orders to M'Bala Nzola (Lens).

53' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He planted a header against the right post and it glanced away off it.
52' The referee awards a corner and Moses Simon (Nantes) goes over to take it.
52' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Jonathan Gradit (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play.
50' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) escapes his marker to connect with a cross and heads it low towards the right side of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent save to deny him.

49' Mathew Ryan was forced into action to thwart Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
46' Andy Diouf will be replaced by Jeremy Agbonifo (Lens).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Facundo Medina (Lens) for his blatant foul.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
45' The corner kick from Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Lens.
40' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
38' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! Louis Leroux (Nantes) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

36' What a save from Mathew Ryan! Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
35' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
33' The resulting corner from Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is cleared by the defence.
33' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lens are going to take it.
30' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
29' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
27' Matthis Abline (Nantes) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
21' A cross from Matthis Abline (Nantes) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
19' Lens have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
18' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
14' Matthis Abline (Nantes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
11' Matthis Abline (Nantes) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
11' The free kick is delivered by Moses Simon (Nantes) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
10' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) brings his opponent down. Jerome Brisard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Moses Simon (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
8' The game is interrupted. Wesley Said (Lens) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
5' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Moses Simon (Nantes), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
3' Nantes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jerome Brisard saw the whole situation.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lens will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will officiate today.
